mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lung route to the blood circuit was most worthwhile: the shrinking oxygen arrows showed why flowing blood also needs renewed air.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the lining and capillary mesh felt somewhat repetitive because each result pointed directly to the next part, though the sequence clarified the separate sides of the exchange surface.

surprise.text: The pleural sheets sliding while resisting separation gave me a clearer picture of how chest movement can pull the lungs outward.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the descriptions gave each connection a purpose.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how the oxygen-delivery route supports other body systems, though I would hope for more decisions with competing possibilities.
